name: Animal Friendship
description:
Choose an animal within short range. You and the animal must be able to see and hear each other. Roll Persuade vs Insight. On a win, for the next day, the animal is convinced that you mean it no harm. If you or an ally attack the animal, the spell ends.

Describe how you calm the animal.
successes:
✨: The effects lasts for an additional day.

🌞: The creature considers you a friend. It will follow and defend you, though you have no special ability to communicate with it.
